title: AFP Reaffirms Resolve to Defend West Philippine Sea, Safeguard Nation’s Future
intro_html: CAMP AGUINALDO, Quezon City -- The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP), led by AFP Chief of Staff General Romeo S Brawner Jr., reaffirmed its unwavering commitment to defending the country's sovereignty as it marked the upcoming 10th anniversary of the 2016 Arbitral Ruling on the West Philippine Sea during the Flag Raising Ceremony on July 6 here.
image_caption: AFP officers and personnel watch an audiovisual presentation on the West Philippine Sea (WPS), highlighting the significance of the 2016 Arbitral Ruling and reaffirming the AFP’s commitment to protecting the country's national interests during the Flag Raising Ceremony at Camp Aguinaldo on July 6.
body_html:
CAMP AGUINALDO, Quezon City -- The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP), led by AFP Chief of Staff General Romeo S Brawner Jr., reaffirmed its unwavering commitment to defending the country's sovereignty as it marked the upcoming 10th anniversary of the 2016 Arbitral Ruling on the West Philippine Sea during the Flag Raising Ceremony on July 6 here.

The ceremony was attended by officers and personnel from all AFP units, highlighting the organization’s unified commitment to protecting the nation’s sovereign rights and national interests.

In his remarks, General Brawner underscored that the significance of the arbitral ruling extends beyond protecting the country's maritime domain, “Above all, it reminds us that our service is not only about protecting our seas. It is about protecting the future of every Filipino. Atin ang West Philippine Sea. Atin ang pananagutang ito. Atin ang tungkuling ito—nang may dangal, propesyonalismo, at pagmamahal sa bayan,” General Brawner said.

As the nation approaches the milestone anniversary of the landmark 2016 Arbitral Ruling, the AFP continues to stand firm in defending the country's sovereign rights and promoting a secure future for all Filipinos through honorable, professional, and dedicated service.

Photos by Pfc Carmelotes PN(M) / PAOAFP
